title: SB Mart Sales vs Previous Year

views.label: Full period

hero.verdict_tag: Top line only for this period
hero.headline: For July 2026 against the same period last year, revenue was 41.4M, up +9.26% across the stores included in the comparison.
hero.narrative: Revenue reached 41.4M, up +9.26% year on year. Read two ways, units rose to 23.0M, up +6.01%, and average revenue per item moved to 1.80, up +3.07%. That points to more sold and a higher average return per item, with the model only exposing revenue, units and price for this full-period view. Real demand was also firmer, with units up +6.01% rather than revenue rising on price alone.

contributions.note: ST5 carries the group (+6.88 pts) while ST2 drags it (-1.00 pts).

cards.state: More transactions and higher prices and mix
cards.story: ST5 was the standout mover: revenue rose +429.55% (+2.6M) to 3.2M and added 6.88 points to the group result despite being 7.76% of current revenue. The move sat overwhelmingly in transactions at +417.83%, with basket size nearly flat at +0.03% and price and mix up +2.23%.

cards.state: Thinner baskets, higher prices - revenue up
cards.story: ST4 carried a large share of the gain in a big base: revenue rose +10.56% (+1.2M) to 12.4M, and that contributed 3.13 points to the overall change. Transactions increased +6.43% and price and mix added +9.59%, while basket size thinned by -5.21%.

ST2 was the clearest drag on the group, with revenue down -5.67% (-381K) to 6.3M and taking -1.00 points off the total result. Transactions fell -6.43% and basket size slipped -0.51%, while price and mix rose +1.33%, which softened the decline but did not offset it.

cards.state: Thinner baskets, higher prices - revenue up
cards.story: ST3 moved up, but only modestly for its size: revenue increased +2.21% (+164K) to 7.6M, adding 0.43 points to the group. Transactions rose +4.18%, basket size thinned by -5.20%, and price and mix added +3.49%.

cards.state: Thinner baskets, higher prices - revenue down
cards.story: ST1 was broadly flat in revenue at -0.54% (-65K), but that still matters on a 11.9M base and 28.68% of current revenue. Transactions rose +2.01% and price and mix added +2.05%, while basket size fell -4.47%, leaving the store slightly down overall.

entries.headline: TOYS revenue increased by +101.2K (+16.7%) for July 2026 against the same period last year.
entries.connect: TOYS built that gain with quantity up +25.5K and transactions up +15.0K. Within the section, change in units sold added +89.5K and rate and mix added +11.7K, while ST4 led the store movement at +86.0K.
